claims.content: Religious education aims at a life-friendly, free and humane future for all in a finite world, in line with the basic convictions of all the religious communities responsible for it.

citation.section_anchor: 1.2 Beitrag des Faches zu den Leitperspektiven

claims.cited_text:
Der Religionsunterricht zielt auf

Welt, wie es den Grundüberzeugungen aller ihn verantwortenden Religionsgemeinschaften 
entspricht.

claims.content: Value education presupposes self-confidence and self-reflection; the subject trains a culture of self-perception, self-disclosure and self-assurance in which everyone experiences being accepted and respected.

citation.section_anchor: 1.2 Beitrag des Faches zu den Leitperspektiven

der sich jede und jeder als angenommen und respektiert erfährt

claims.content: In that culture the limitedness of human existence also comes into view, and alongside strengths, weaknesses and mistakes are allowed a place.

in der zugleich auch die Be-

claims.content: Freedom, equality and justice as well as tolerance, respect and a sense of responsibility shape the learning processes and are at the same time the object of learning in the sources of the religions.

Freiheit, Gleichheit, Gerechtigkeit sowie Toleranz,

claims.content: Pupils get to know the diversity of religions, cultures, life views and lifestyles in society and practise a culture of dialogic togetherness free of group-focused enmity.

Die Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen im Religi-

claims.content: The teacher models "exemplary positionality", showing how individual self-determination and religious conviction can be combined with empathetic and respectful regard for other ways of living and thinking.

claims.cited_text:

tung anderer Lebens- und Denkweisen verbunden werden kann.

claims.content: Under education for sustainable development, pupils can experience and reflect on themselves as part of creation and as members of a solidary world community for which they bear responsibility.

claims.cited_text:
Sie können sich als 
Teil der Schöpfung und als Mitglied einer solidarischen Weltgemeinschaft erfahren und reflek-

claims.content: Given the finiteness of resources and the limits of planetary carrying capacity, the subject addresses basic human attitudes towards nature as well as the meaning and purpose of economic and social action.

Angesichts der Endlichkeit der Ressourcen und der Grenzen planetarer Tragfähigkeit thema-

claims.content: Justice and peace are important categories in all religions and serve in religious education as central guiding concepts of ethical and theological reflection.

claims.cited_text:
Gerechtigkeit und Frieden sind wichtige Kategorien in allen Religionen. Im Religionsunterricht

claims.content: Religious education promotes pupils' digital maturity: they learn with digital tools and media and reflect on their life in a digitally shaped world.

claims.cited_text:

claims.content: Communicating and cooperating, producing and presenting also by digital means (competence areas 1, 2 and 3 of the KMK strategy) are a central component of the learning culture in religious education.

claims.content: Digitally supported forms of learning facilitate religion-differentiated learning arrangements that are indispensable for competence acquisition and for implementing the core curricula, especially the B parts.
